ROOT CAUSE: The menu in [app.js](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/B-O1-luna/app/static/js/app.js:3275) sends `PATCH /api/sessions/{name}/tg-topic?scope=…&enabled=…`. That request matches `toggle_tg_topic` in [sessions.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/B-O1-luna/app/routes/sessions.py:3528), which sets `found.tg_topic`, calls `save_session(found.to_dict())`, and returns JSON. But the route is declared after `toggle_tg_topic`’s containing code section ends at line 3536; the stronger check is router registration: this route’s decorator is registered normally, and no method mismatch is evident. Persistence stores `tg_topic`, and refresh serializes it via `AgentSession.to_dict()` or reads it from DB rows.

The first divergence is therefore not established as a backend or persistence failure from these code paths alone. `api()` throws for non-2xx responses, causing the console message, but the snapshot has no runtime DB/server to compare the actual response and persisted value. Focused tests were not present in the snapshot.
